title: dam edit request
description: The flags dam edit takes, one key per flag without its dashes, and oid for its argument. A no_ key clears the field its name ends in, so the two never come together.

oid.description: An oid or prefix of 4 or more hex characters, or an array of them for several objects.

filter.description: Act on every object this saved filter lists; inside a project, only its tasks unless global.

preview.description: Answer the changes and write nothing.

expect.description: Refuse, changing nothing, unless the set holds exactly this many objects.

as_one.description: For a token: the changes wait as one set the owner takes or declines whole.

editor.description: A request cannot open an editor.

due.description: A date word, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

deadline.description: A date word, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

items.description: An oid, or a prefix of 4 or more hex characters.
An oid, or a prefix of 4 or more hex characters.

recurrence.description: A rule such as every 2 weeks on mon.

attached.description: An oid, or a prefix of 4 or more hex characters.

start.description: A date word, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

end.description: A date word, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

category.description: A label group's label, as GROUP=LABEL, such as effort=deep: an object of group to label, or an array of GROUP=LABEL for several labels of one group. A label of none takes the group's label off.

global.description: Pick the saved filter's objects from every task, not only the project the command runs in.

project.description: Pick the saved filter's objects from the project at this path, such as pns/hooks/, from any folder. Not with global.

meta.description: The request's details, as --meta KEY=VALUE passes them: harness, session, model, effort, version or any other key.
